metadata.title: Fatigue Testing of the MK3 Mod0 2000 Lb Bail Lugs: Test Report
metadata.author: Jaeger, J. L.
metadata.subject: This report details the procedure and results obtained for fatigue tests conducted on 2000 lb bail lugs in accordance with MIL-HDBK-5E.
